skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the objectives of financial analysis from the perspective of company managers, lenders, and stock analysts.
Describe the importance and relationships between financial statements in financial analysis.
Describe the basic content of each step in the financial analysis process.
Understand the definitions, uses, and limitations of tools and techniques used in financial analysis.
Calculate and explain financial ratios of a company.
Use financial ratios and other tools to assess the financial situation of a company and forecast future financial conditions.
Identify financial issues of a company through financial analysis and propose solutions and recommendations.
Understand methods of financial analysis (horizontal, vertical, ratio group analysis, DuPont analysis).
Understand how to determine and explain financial ratios in various groups of financial analysis (liquidity, operational efficiency, capital structure, profitability, growth).
Identify strengths and weaknesses in a company's business operations.
Propose solutions to leverage strengths and mitigate weaknesses in business operations.
Detect basic forms of financial statement fraud in practice.
Develop and defend personal viewpoints on financial analysis issues in practice.
Develop teamwork skills to complete group assignments and discussions.
Manage time effectively to complete all assignments with high efficiency.
Recognize and practice social responsibility and professional ethics in financial analysis.
Organize, evaluate, and inspire team members in assigned tasks and social activities.
